sm: This week's lowest restaurant health scores in Middle Tennessee were 63 for Jim Bob Grill in Clarksville, 66 for Kyber Grill in South Nashville, 71 for Nashville Biscuit House, and 72 for Sweet Peas Southern Style in Clarksville. Inspectors cited food handling, improper cooling, and spoiled produce. Re-inspections improved scores at several restaurants, ranging from 88 to 95.
